item.tib: rdzogs pa chen po yongs rtse klong chen gyi drang don gyi las 'bras ston pa'i 'grel pa snang ba 'od kyi 'khor lo'i rgyan
item.coloph: kun mkhyen gnyis pa lta bu'i gsung skyong ba/ gshen gyi drang srong nam mkha' 'od zer la/ bslab gsum khur gyis dal 'byor lus mdzes shing*/ sde snod mang du smra ba'i dbang 'byor ba/ bshes gnyen grags pas yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ legs par sbyar ba'i dge rtsa rnam dkar 'dis/ 'gro kun lam 'dir nyer zhugs rgyud sbyang nas/ sgrib gnyis byang zhing tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs te/ kun mkhyen rnam rgyal lta bu'i sku thob shog ces pa 'di ni chu mo lug gi lo ston zla ra ba'i tshes bco lnga la/ g.yung drung sgang du grub pa 'di/ 'phel nas sems can gyi don byed kho nar gyur cig/
